section.title: VENTPRIME is a family company with five years of experience.

paragraphs: We have completed 500 projects: we install ventilation systems, perform diamond core drilling and treat indoor spaces. We help improve air exchange and solve problems related to dampness, stuffy air and condensation.
Clients recommend us to friends and family. We explain the included work, agree on costs upfront and carry out the installation with care.
We provide a warranty for the completed work, under the terms of the contract.
Natural ventilation uses differences in pressure and temperature to set air in motion.
The intake point is placed lower down, as close to the radiator as possible. Outdoor air enters through the valve, is distributed by the indoor unit and mixes with the warm air in the room.
Warm air rises and, when the required draft is present, is exhausted through the upper outlet point. Along with it, part of the accumulated moisture is removed.
The valves can remain open non-stop. The intensity and direction of airflow depend on temperature, wind and the conditions of the building.

condensation.title: Why do windows fog up?
condensation.imageAlt: Condensation and water droplets on a window pane
paragraphs: Moisture builds up indoors from breathing, cooking, showering and drying laundry. If the air is not renewed sufficiently, humidity rises.
When humid air comes into contact with cold windows and walls, condensation can form. Prolonged dampness creates favorable conditions for moisture and mold.
Ventilation helps remove excess humidity. Water leaks and structural freezing require separate remedial measures.

items.question: How many valves are needed for one room?
items.answer: Our standard set for a bedroom or living room up to 25 m² includes two points: one for intake and one for exhaust. The price with complete installation is {roomPrice}.

items.question: Will there be a lot of dust and dirt during drilling?
items.answer: No. We work carefully and use professional equipment with dust extraction or water collection. Very little dust is produced. After installation, we clean the work area.

items.question: Will there be drafts?
items.answer: The indoor unit distributes air through side openings, reducing the feeling of a direct jet. Airflow can be adjusted. Comfort also depends on temperature, wind and installation location.

items.question: What are the heat losses?
items.answer: Outdoor air needs to be heated. Whenever possible, we place the intake near the radiator so incoming air mixes with the warm indoor air. Temperature change depends on conditions; we do not guarantee a fixed 1–2 degree loss.

items.question: Does ventilation help against mold?
items.answer: It helps remove excess humidity when air exchange is insufficient. Existing mold requires separate treatment, and water leaks or structural freezing must be remedied.

items.question: Do the valves require maintenance?
items.answer: Simple maintenance is needed: cleaning the filter and grilles. The washable filter should be rinsed and completely dried according to the manufacturer's instructions.

items.question: Can I find out the price without an on-site inspection?
items.answer: Yes. Consultation by phone, photos and video is free. For standard jobs, the cost can be agreed preliminarily remotely.

items.question: How can I get the discount on mold treatment?
